contact.title: Need a {demo} or help?
contact.text: Reach out to us and we will show you around Bonfiire, help you set up your first Appro or event, or answer any question you have along the way.

items.title: Manage Checkpoint
items.text: Add a checkpoint host at each checkpoint, or print out a QR code for places where no host is present.

items.title: Digital Appro Map
items.text: Interactive digital map for everyone, from the meeting point to every checkpoint and the way between them.

items.title: Ticket scanner
items.text: Scan participant's ticket with in-app camera, or search them through the participant list in seconds.

items.title: Scoring leaderboard
items.text: Score every activity for each participant and group, and watch the standings change as the day goes.

items.title: Audit trails
items.text: Clear trail of participants joins, check-ins and withdrawls, so you always know who did what and when.

items.title: Shared photo album
items.text: Hosts and participants can share their pictures in one place, to mark the day memories.

items.title: Paid ticket sales
items.text: Sell yours Appro tickets within bonfiire app. Analyze and see how many tickets have been sold.

checkpoint.title:
Hosting an {Appro}
 has never been easier

steps.title: Add Appro event info
steps.text: Give your Appro a title and a description, and set when it starts and ends, so everyone knows what is happening and when.

description.label: Description
description.value: Five stops round the city centre, with a game at every checkpoint.

steps.title: Mark checkpoints
steps.text: Drop the meeting point and then every checkpoint on the map, in the order the groups walk them.

steps.title: Invite checkpoint hosts
steps.text: Invite a host for each checkpoint straight from the app. Once they accept, the checkpoint is ready to welcome groups.

steps.title: Build up your participants
steps.text: Invite people straight from the app or share the event link so people can join them easily.

steps.title: Ticket sales
steps.text: Tickets are free for now, so participants can join right away. Selling paid tickets in the app is coming soon.

steps.title: Appro map for participants
steps.text: Every participant has the whole route on their phone, from the meeting point to every checkpoint and the way between them.

steps.title: Check-in with QR code
steps.text: The host and the checkpoint hosts check participants in with the in-app camera, or find them in the participant list in seconds.

steps.title: Make it more fun with scoring
steps.text: Give points for every activity, to each participant or group, and watch the leaderboard change as the day goes.

steps.title: Share the moments
steps.text: Hosts and participants add their photos to one shared album, so the whole day stays together.

steps.title: Keep track of everything
steps.text: Every join, check-in and score is saved, so you always know who did what and when.

participate.title: Taking part in an {Appro?}
text: Your ticket, the date and the start time, and a live map of the whole route are all in the Bonfiire app. Follow the way from checkpoint to checkpoint, check in with a quick scan at every stop, collect your stamps and points, and see how your group is doing as the day goes on.
participate.sceneAlt: Illustration of three cards fanned out: a small map of an Appro route with its checkpoints, the date and start time in the middle, and a ticket with its QR code.

why.title: Why {Bonfiire}?
text: Student life is full of people, yet it's easy to feel on your own. Plans get lost in group chats, and good events never reach the people who'd love them.

We built Bonfiire to change that, one place to find things to do, bring your own ideas to life and meet the people around you. Like friends around the bonfire, we want people to come closer, and stay close long after the event ends.

ways.title: Services we provide for your {event}
text: Host an event on Bonfiire and bring everyone together, in one place or spread out across the city.

items.mapLabel: A small map with one pin: everything happens in one place.
items.title: Single-location event
items.text: Everything happens in one place. Send the invites, share the details, and welcome everyone in with an e-ticket.

items.mapLabel: A small map with four numbered checkpoints joined by a route.
items.title: Multi-checkpoint event
items.text: The event moves from stop to stop, with a host and a quick QR check-in at every checkpoint, and points or stamps along the way.

appros.title: Some Appro {ideas}
text: Every Appro on Bonfiire has its own route, checkpoints and games. Pick the one that fits your crowd.

hostAppro.title: Are you hosting or planning your upcoming {Appro?}
text: Bonfiire walks you through it, from planning the route and inviting checkpoint hosts to checking groups in and keeping score. Everything your team needs is in the app.
hostAppro.sceneAlt: Illustration of a small city map where the stops of a route drop onto the map one after another, the meeting point, then checkpoints 1, 2 and 3, like pins being placed while planning it.

hostGathering.title: {Planning} a company Christmas party, a house party or a birthday{?}
text: Let Bonfiire take care of most of the work, send the invites, share the details, hand out e-tickets and check everyone in at the door, so you can enjoy it too.
hostGathering.sceneAlt: Illustration of a party: a striped party hat that jumps and lands with a wobble, a wrapped present with a fluttering bow and a bunch of balloons tied to its lid that lift it a little, letting out a puff of confetti that tumbles down onto the floor.

onePlace.title:
Not just appro, 
you can keep it in {one place} too
text: Not every event needs a route. For a house party, a sitsit or an afternoon of board games, send the invites, share the details and welcome everyone at the door.

venues.label: House party
venues.summary: Music in the living room, food in the kitchen and a table on the balcony. Everyone shows their e-ticket at the door.
venues.about: Invite friends and relatives for your house party or special occasion, track their RSVPs effortlessly, and host a stress-free celebration.
venues.imageAlt: Illustration of a city with a house in the middle: a living room with a sofa, a rug and party lights where guests dance, an L-shaped kitchen by the front door with a pot cooking on the stove, a bedroom with a double bed, bedside lamps, a mirror and a wardrobe, a grey-tiled WC with a small wooden sauna (benches and a stove with steam rising), a shower, a sink and a toilet, and a small balcony with a round table, plants and fairy lights. A few guests are already there; more small groups arrive along the streets from every side; at the front door each group shows a QR code on a phone, the host just inside ticks them in, and each group heads to the living room, the kitchen or the balcony while a counter by the door goes up.

venues.label: Birthday celebration
venues.summary: Balloons, a cake and presents for the birthday person. Guests check in at the door and put on a party hat.
venues.about: Gather your favorite people to celebrate a birthday, easily keep track of who is coming, and enjoy a fun, hassle-free party from start to finish.
venues.imageAlt: Illustration of a city with a house in the middle, decorated for a birthday: colourful bunting and a "Happy birthday!" banner along the living room wall, a birthday cake with lit candles on a small table under the banner, party hats on the tables, a pile of wrapped presents by the front door with balloons tied to it, more balloons by the walls and on the balcony, confetti over the dance floor, and bursts of confetti and gold glitter from the banner over the guests. A few guests are already there; more small groups arrive along the streets from every side; at the front door each group shows a QR code on a phone, the host just inside ticks them in, and each group heads to the living room, the kitchen or the balcony, everyone in a party hat, those who sit down putting their presents on the table, while a counter by the door goes up.

venues.label: Sitsit
venues.summary: Long tables, a live band and waiters bringing food and drinks. Guests check in at the door and sit together.
venues.about: Bring your company, group, or community together for a vibrant sitsit party, easily track attendees, and host a lively, perfectly coordinated celebration.
venues.imageAlt: Illustration of a city with a hall in the middle: two long tables running across it, set with white cloths, plates and candles; a live band on a small stage along one wall (an acoustic guitarist, a singer and a drummer); down the other wall a bar facing the room, where one bartender shakes a cocktail and another mixes drinks, with guests on stools facing it; waiters carry trays of drinks and food. A few guests are already seated; more small groups arrive along the streets from every side; outside the door each group shows a QR code on a phone, the host just inside ticks them in, and each group sits together along a table, drinks in front of them, while a counter by the door goes up.

venues.label: Live music
venues.summary: A stage, a bar and a lawn that fills up. Groups scan in at the entrance and head straight to the music.
venues.about: Invite fans and the local community to your live music event, track RSVPs effortlessly, and host a smooth, stress-free gig.
venues.imageAlt: Illustration of a city with a fenced lawn in the middle, with a stage at its back (a singer, a DJ and light beams), a bar and two portable toilets. Small groups of guests arrive along the streets from every side; at the entrance each group shows a QR code on a phone, the host standing just inside ticks them in, and each group walks to its own spot on the lawn to dance together while a counter by the gate goes up, until the lawn is full.

venues.label: Your next event
venues.summary: Host a meetup, an afternoon of board games, or something entirely new. Send invites and welcome guests smoothly with an e-ticket.
venues.about: Bring any idea to life, from a casual meetup to an afternoon of board games. Easily send out invites, share event details, and welcome everyone at the door with an e-ticket for a seamless experience.
venues.imageAlt: Illustration of a city with an empty plot in the middle, marked out with a dashed line, where a pin drops into the middle with ripples spreading out round it, waiting for an event.

finale.title: Let's start making memories.
text: Student life goes fast. Don't waste it.
